ov: اشترينا حديقة حيوان (الإنجليزية: We Bought a Zoo) هو فيلم دراما كوميدي أُصدر في الولايات المتحدة صدر في 2011. الفيلم من إخراج كاميرون كرو وكتابة ألين بروش ماكينا وكاميرون كرو، ومن بطولة مات ديمون وسكارليت جوهانسون وتوماس هادن تشورتش وباتريك فيوجيت وإيل فانينغ.
plotEn:
Seven months after the death of his wife Katherine, Benjamin Mee's 14-year-old son Dylan is expelled from school. Benjamin realizes the family could benefit from a fresh start, starting with moving to a new house. Benjamin and his children find none to their liking, until his 7-year-old daughter Rosie sees a listing for a large old estate. Their realtor, Mr. Stevens, tries to dissuade them, explaining that if they want the property, they must also buy a dilapidated zoo on site, which closed several years earlier. After seeing Rosie playing happily with peacocks, Benjamin resolves to buy both the house and the zoo. Dylan, frustrated by the idea of moving away from his friends, retreats into art. 
Benjamin's accountant brother, Duncan, tries to discourage him from the purchase, but he is undeterred. The zoo staff, led by head keeper Kelly Foster, start making renovations to reopen the zoo to the public. Meanwhile, Dylan befriends Kelly's 13-year-old homeschooled cousin, Lily, who develops a crush on him. When the zoo's tiger begins experiencing health complications, Benjamin tries to medicate his food, which the tiger refuses to eat. Kelly urges Benjamin to let him go, but Benjamin refuses.
